project.title: Microbial Community Characterization in Advanced Water Reclamation for Potable Reuse
project.description: Microbial community characterization across two treatment barriers for potable reuse-Case Study Reno,NV. Coagulation/Flocculation/Clarification/ Granular Media Filtration and Ozonation/Biological Activated Carbon Filtration were investigated. Samples were collected to study the microbial community changes along with the treatment train.
